# Summary

Read in processed Luminex data and summarize

# Preamble

```{r preamble}
library(here)
here()
#----------------------------
# source the config file
#----------------------------
source(here("R","0-config.R"))
```

# Load the WASHB serology data

```{r}
#| label: load antibody data
#-------------------------------
# load the formatted MBA data
# for WASH Benefits Bangladesh, 
# created by
# 5-seropositivity_cutoffs.Qmd
#
# data are in long format
# by child-visit-antigen
#-------------------------------
d1 <- read_rds(file = here("../../data/bangl/luminex/final/","washb_bangl_luminex_igg_seropos_2026-01-29.rds")) %>%
  mutate(
    antigen_plot = antigen_lab,
    antigen_plot = recode(
      antigen_plot,
      "Salmonella HylE" = "Salmonella HlyE"
    ))

#-------------------------------
# report the number of kids and
# samples
#-------------------------------
cat("\n\nTHE DATA INCLUDE",length(unique(d1$sampleid)), "SAMPLES FROM",length(unique(d1$childid)),"CHILDREN\n")

#-------------------------------
# estimate seroprevalence by
# antigen and visit
# for exact binomial 95% CIs, ignore clustering
# (reasonable for now)
#-------------------------------
dprev <- d1 %>%
  filter(!antigen %in% "gst") %>%
  group_by(pathogen,antigen,antigen_lab,visit) %>%
  summarize(nobs = n(),
            npos = sum(seropos,na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(seroprev = npos/nobs,
         seroprev_lb = binom.test(x=npos,n=nobs)$conf.int[1],
         seroprev_ub = binom.test(x=npos,n=nobs)$conf.int[2]
         )
```

# Summary of age by visit

Visit 1 represents mainly maternal IgG responses, as nearly all measurements from visit 1 were among children <6 months old.

```{r}
#| label: Examine age distributions



#---------------------------------
# examine age distributions
#---------------------------------
d1_child <- d1 %>% group_by(sampleid) %>% slice(1)
by(data=d1_child,d1_child$visit,function(x) summary(x$agemonth))
by(data=d1_child,d1_child$visit,function(x) sd(x$agemonth, na.rm=TRUE))

ggplot(d1_child, aes(x=agemonth,fill=factor(visit)),group=(visit)) + 
  geom_histogram(alpha=0.7,bins=40, position = "identity") + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0,36,by=6)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette="Dark2") +
  labs(x = "Age in months", y = "Number of measurements") +
  theme_minimal() 

ggplot(d1_child, aes(x=agemonth,fill=eed),group=eed) + 
  geom_histogram(alpha=0.7,bins=40, position = "identity") + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0,36,by=6)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=cbpal[c(2,3)]) +
  labs(x = "Age in months", y = "Number of measurements") +
  theme_minimal() 

#---------------------------------
# samples by visit and EED substudy
#---------------------------------
table(d1_child$visit, d1_child$eed)

```

# Enteric pathogens

```{r}
#| label: plot age-dependent patterns enterics

#-------------------------------
# group antigens by pathogen
# and loop over them
# plotting age-MFI and 
# age-seroprevalence by antigen
#-------------------------------

# custom log labels
log10labs <- c( 
  expression(10^0),
  expression(10^1),
  expression(10^2),
  expression(10^3),
  expression(10^4)
)


# get the list of pathogens (exclude schisto GST)
# pathogens <- unique(d1$pathogen[d1$pathogen!="Schistosoma"])
pathogens <- c("Campylobacter","Cholera","Cryptosporidium","E. histolytica","Giardia","LT-ETEC","Norovirus","Salmonella","Shigella")

for(i in 1:length(pathogens)) {
  
  # filter to the pathogen
  di <- d1 %>% filter(pathogen == pathogens[i])
  dprevi <- dprev %>% filter(pathogen == pathogens[i])
  
  # plot age-MFI
  # limit smooth to 33 months to avoid edge effects
  print(
    ggplot(data=di, aes(x=agemonth, y = log10mfi)) + 
    facet_wrap(.~antigen_lab) + 
    geom_point(alpha=0.5,size=0.5, color=nytpal2[1]) + 
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept=log10(mficut)),lty="dashed") +
    geom_smooth(data=di %>% filter(agemonth<=33), method = "gam", se=FALSE,color="black",lwd=0.5) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=0:4,labels = log10labs) + 
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,36,by=6)) + 
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,4.75), x=c(0,36)) +
    labs(x = "Age (months)", y = "IgG Luminex response (MFI-bg)") + 
    theme_minimal()
  )
  
  # plot age seroprev
  # limit smooth to 32 months to avoid edge effects
  print(
    ggplot(data=di, aes(x=agemonth, y = seropos)) + 
    facet_wrap(.~antigen_lab) + 
    geom_point(alpha=0.5,size=0.5, color=nytpal2[1]) + 
    geom_smooth(data=di %>% filter(agemonth<=32), method = "gam", se=FALSE,color="black",lwd=0.5) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,1,by=0.2), labels = sprintf("%1.0f",seq(0,1,by=0.2)*100)) + 
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,36,by=6)) + 
    labs(x = "Age (months)", y = "IgG seroprevalence (%)") + 
    theme_minimal()
  )
  
    # plot serprev by visit
  print(
    ggplot(data=dprevi, aes(x=factor(visit), y = seroprev, color=visit)) + 
    facet_wrap(.~antigen_lab) + 
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = seroprev_lb, ymax = seroprev_ub), width=0.2) +
      geom_point() + 
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,1,by=0.2), labels = sprintf("%1.0f",seq(0,1,by=0.2)*100)) + 
      scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
      coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,1)) +
      labs(x = "Visit", y = "IgG seroprevalence (%)") + 
      theme_minimal()
  )
  
}


```
